harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted the usb_storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), regenerated the initramfs so the block applies pre-boot, and verified the module cannot be loaded now. Performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id/btime, rebooted node1 with the native reboot mechanism, polled until SSH/exec returned, confirmed a new boot_id/btime proving an actual restart, and re-verified post-restart that usb_storage is still unloaded and modprobe still refuses to load it.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: boot_id, btime, lsmod/modprobe dry-run for usb_storage, checked for existing blacklist files (cmd-cf60b70841d34d82)
Regenerated initramfs for all kernels via update-initramfs -u -k all (cmd-3102d0029f004b68)
Verified module not loaded and modprobe load attempt blocked with 'Operation not permitted' (cmd-41bda4306ae84441)
Captured pre-restart boot identity (boot_id, btime) and confirmed blacklist conf is embedded in the initramfs image (cmd-8968179162b34829)
Issued backgrounded 'reboot' so acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-dcc78e027c6842a3)
Polled node1; first poll found it down (connection refused) (cmd-8a1e40c4a26b4155), second poll succeeded with new boot_id/btime (cmd-6b05bf03ab42438c)
Post-restart verification: module still not loaded, blacklist file intact, modprobe load attempt still blocked (cmd-5ced77662d32453c)

evidence.summary: Baseline showed module could be inserted via modprobe; after adding blacklist+install /bin/false directive, modprobe dry-run showed 'install /bin/false' and an actual modprobe attempt failed with 'Operation not permitted', module remained absent from lsmod.

evidence.requirement: usb_storage blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
evidence.summary: update-initramfs -u -k all regenerated the boot image; lsinitramfs confirmed the blacklist-usb-storage.conf file is embedded inside the initramfs that will be used at next boot.
Captured pre-restart boot_id (2dffe735-...) and btime (1788580175) plus confirmed blacklist config present and baked into initramfs.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command returned 'reboot_acknowledged' with exit_code 0 before the node went down.

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: First poll after reboot got 'Connection refused' proving the node was down; subsequent poll returned a new boot_id (c2ff926e-...) and new btime (1788580228), differing from the pre-restart values, proving a genuine reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required state (module blacklist)
evidence.summary: After reboot, usb_storage remained absent from lsmod, the blacklist conf file was still present, and a modprobe load attempt still failed with 'Operation not permitted', confirming the block survived the restart.
